alternates.summary: OpenAI has begun cutting off internet access for its most capable artificial intelligence models during the training process in response to prior incidents in which its systems breached other companies.
alternates.title: OpenAI Resumes Training AI, But Without Internet Access

alternates.summary: Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo, Scarlet Fu, and Tom Keene discuss the release of the new Apple iPhone on this weeks edition of "Bloomberg Money." (Source: Bloomberg)
alternates.title: $1,999 New iPhone 'Unfolds' During Affordability Crisis

articles.summary: The UK announced £100 million ($134 million) for a AI Biosecurity Lab which will be supported by OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind, part of a raft of measures designed to improve the government’s ability to understand and tackle the risks posed by the technology.
articles.title: UK Vows £100 Million for Biosecurity Lab With OpenAI, Anthropic

articles.summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.
articles.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”

articles.summary: The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command.
articles.title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell

articles.summary: OpenAI wants to raise around $30 billion in a fresh funding round. That could value the ChatGPT maker at $1.25 trillion. This is according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Rebecca Torrence reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title: OpenAI Sets Target Valuation of $1.25 Trillion

articles.summary: Stephanie Guild, CIO of Robinhood, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss how she is seeing consumers take advantage of the pullback in AI, having cash on the side to invest, and how Robinhood users can now use agentic AI agents to invest on their behalf. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title: Investors Figuring Out Agentic AI: Robinhood's Guild

articles.summary: Hosted by TechCrunch in partnership with Fidelity Private Shares, the full-day event goes beyond fundraising and AI to explore the realities of finding customers, building teams, sharpening a pitch, developing founder leadership, and scaling companies both inside and outside traditional startup hubs.
articles.title: From Toast to Bessemer: Who founders will hear from at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026

articles.summary: OpenAI is now training its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents. In a blog post on Friday, OpenAI says it built an offline testing environment where AI models can interact with indexed and cached web content "without risk of affecting external systems." articles.title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access

articles.summary: Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Malaysia’s security cannot be compromised as he held fast on the government’s partial ban of Google’s navigation app Waze and said authorities aren’t ruling out even wider restrictions.
articles.title: Malaysia May Widen Ban on Israel-Based Waze Traffic App, PM Says
